trainedOn: 200 paired before & after scenes (200 before, 200 after - 400 samples total)

plastic.high: Urgent dry-waste clearance required. Dispatch municipal recyclables collection truck, equip crew with puncture-resistant safety gloves, and route segregated plastics to authorized recycling center.
plastic.medium: Segregate dry plastics from organic waste. Schedule municipal van pickup and inspect adjacent storm drains for plastic bag blockage.
plastic.low: Community bin collection and routine dry-waste segregation recommended.

household.high: Intensive domestic waste accumulation. Deploy municipal compactor truck, sanitize perimeter with lime powder, and place covered community bins.
household.medium: Standard door-to-door waste vehicle dispatch. Clear cardboard packaging and sanitize surrounding sidewalk.
household.low: Provide community recycling hamper and monitor for illegal dumping.

organic.high: Bio-degradable wet waste pile. Divert immediately within 24h to decentralized municipal composting unit; spray microbial odor neutralizer to curb flies.
organic.medium: Collect and divert to park composting pit. Sanitize moist pavement.
organic.low: Garden leaf compost pile; sweep into botanical mulch bed.

construction.high: Heavy demolition rubble. Deploy hydraulic tipper truck and tractor loader. Require safety boots, dust masks, and clear pedestrian walkway immediately.
construction.medium: Clear masonry bricks and cracked tiles. Transport to local C&D recycling processing plant.
construction.low: Stack reusable bricks neatly and sweep fine mortar dust.

near_water.high: Critical waterway choke. Deploy water trash boom barriers and floating rakes. Clear drainage culvert immediately to avoid monsoon flooding.
near_water.medium: Remove floating plastic bottles and debris bags from canal banks. Inspect downstream screen.
near_water.low: Routine watercourse litter clearance along riverbank.
